subline.text: Bring a little retro Halloween mischief to your next creative night in.

scenes.brief: Dark walnut desk with a softly worn finish, lit by a warm desk lamp and a faint cool moonlit edge. Add a small amber-glass candle, scattered autumn leaves and a couple of muted orange pumpkin accents; palette of charcoal, cream, rust and deep plum.
scenes.prompt:
Environment-only background photograph for a premium Etsy product listing image (square).
Clean catalogue flat lay photographed from directly above: a plain, pale stone surface, even soft studio light with very light shadows, one coloured pencil lying at one edge and nothing else. Keep the right-hand two thirds of the surface clear, even and softly lit, reserved for products added later.
Campaign mood: moody atmospheric Halloween.
Mood: Cheeky, nostalgic, mischievous and lightly macabre; humorous spooky escapism for adults.
Photographic and realistic: soft warm light, shallow depth of field, premium and inviting. Environment only.
Do NOT include: colouring pages, colouring books, books, notebooks, sketchbooks, sheets of paper, printed pages, paper artwork, drawings, line art, illustrations, posters, frames, screens, text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks, people, hands, animals.

examples.purpose: Coloured example of a real page (marketing illustration only; the product is black-and-white line art).
examples.prompt:
Colour in this exact colouring-book page as a finished example for an Etsy listing image.
Keep every black line exactly as it is: do not add, remove, move, redraw or restyle any line, object, pattern or lettering, and keep the whole page with its white margins visible.
Fill the enclosed areas neatly, as if coloured with coloured pencils and felt-tip markers: harmonious, natural colours with gentle shading inside the shapes.
Colour mood: moody atmospheric Halloween, Halloween feeling.
Output: a flat, straight-on image of the coloured page on white paper. No table, hands, pencils, shadows, frame, border, added text, signature or watermark.
